artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan replacing the unconditional handoff-write section in all 21 research-agent contract files with a single canonical prohibition, fixing 4 files' extra cross-references/bullets, correcting handoff-schema.md's misattributed citation, and closing with a repo-wide acceptance grep.

memory_candidates.content: When deleting a copy-templated contract section from many agent files, first grep the section for instructions that exist ONLY inside it. Observed case: the .orchestrator-handoff.json section in 20 extension research-agent contracts was the sole carrier of the 'echo dispatch_seq verbatim' instruction; deleting the section wholesale would have silently dropped that instruction from all 20 files (core's copy was safe only because it separately repeated it for .return-meta.json). Redirect such orphaned instructions in the replacement text rather than losing them with the section.
